User-review redesign: A slightly overweight forty-one-year-old Chinese station attendant with tired watchful eyes and one loose uniform button grips a scratched old metal thermos while counting floor tiles with a guarded unsmiling expression under soft even frontal studio light; the strict cowboy shot ends at mid-thigh.
sceneConcept: A slightly overweight forty-one-year-old Chinese station attendant walks alone against a transparent background as if quietly counting floor tiles. He has short black hair beginning to grey, brown eyes, faint stubble and an approachable tired face. His faded blue-grey station jacket is completely plain over a white collared shirt; one middle button hangs loose and leaves a small gap, with straight black trousers and black office shoes below. One hand carries a scratched old olive-green metal thermos low at his side while his gaze tracks the unseen floor. Soft even frontal studio light creates no station, doors, maps, signs, writing, threshold effects or bright rim.
